title: Database Monitoring us2 realm conflicts with its Google Cloud region column
problem: The current US Database Monitoring row lists us2 in the realm column and None in the Google Cloud regions column. The realm equivalence table maps us2 to Google Cloud Oregon (us-west1). The prior reviewed table omitted us2 in this component row. Treat the two current cells as conflicting guidance for Database Monitoring in Google Cloud Oregon. APM and Agent Observability have separate component rows. Tenant enablement, entitlement, historical rollout and FedRAMP authorization remain separate.

audiences: Readers planning Observability Cloud component coverage
exclusions: No inferred tenant rollout, entitlement, historical availability or regulated authorization.

scopeComparison: Both cells are in the same current US Database Monitoring row. The separate realm mapping identifies the provider and region for us2.

impact.customerScenario: Scoping Database Monitoring in Google Cloud Oregon.
impact.consequence: Planning from either cell alone risks assuming unsupported deployment coverage or excluding a usable realm.

confidence.rationale: Direct publisher table checked. The observation establishes the documentation conflict and leaves actual availability unresolved.

evidence.statement: The realm equivalence table maps us2 to Google Cloud Oregon (us-west1).
